title: Delivery answer, contract version 1
description: The body of a 200 answer of the delivery API's GET /v1/resolve (PRD 8.8, 8.9): the record of what the path shows and what it is. Every other answer is a problem details document of problem.v1.json, and an answer with debug=1 a document of delivery-explanation.v1.json. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Delivery\Domain\Dto\DeliveryDocument, and the generated codec DeliveryCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

data.description: The record, in the record contract of the type meta names, exactly as that type's generated codec wrote it at the public classification access: the entry's id under cms_id and each public field. Validate it with the validator of that type's record contract.

meta.description: What the record is: its type, the locale, the canonical URL and the version of the record contract.

canonical_url.description: The canonical URL of the entry in the locale (PRD 5.7), or null when the reader can read no canonical placement with a URL.

contract.description: The version of the record contract the record is written in (RecordCodecs::VERSION), 1.

locale.description: The locale of the record, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS.

type.description: The name of the record's type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post; the record is in that type's record contract.
